Gothic is a batteries-included Go framework for building full-stack apps.
It prioritizes simplicity and productivity.

## Goals

- **Fullstack Go** Go is the only language you write
- **Simplicity** Optimized for readability

## A taste

Read the [quickstart](docs/guide/01-quickstart.md), browse
[examples/guestbook](examples/guestbook), or open the
[reference](docs/SYNTAX.md).

```templ
type Model struct{ Count int }
```
